data.content_ref: inline:Artifact 0e26d6be54fd abstracts from both SRC_004 and SRC_005: it generalizes the pattern of 'what the machine currently holds' (SRC_004) together with the pattern of 'when conjecture circles into basin exhaustion' (SRC_005) into a higher-level meta-claim about the lifecycle of held propositions — specifically, a framework that subsumes both the inventory of current holdings and the dynamics of how those holdings enter and exit attractor basins. The relation is abstraction because 0e26d6be54fd operates at a level of description above both artifacts, treating them as special cases. REFUTED IF 0e26d6be54fd is at the same or lower level of description as SRC_004 or SRC_005 (i.e., it is an instance or application rather than a generalization), or if it addresses only one of the two and not their common superstructure.
